Synopsis: The remote host runs a Java application using a vulnerable Log4j library.
Description: JNDI lookup injection in Log4j 2.x allows unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted log messages.
Solution: Upgrade Apache Log4j to 2.17.1 or later.

Plugin Name: MS17-010: Security Update for Microsoft Windows SMB Server (ETERNALBLUE)
Synopsis: The remote Windows host is affected by multiple SMBv1 vulnerabilities.
Description: Remote code execution in SMBv1, exploited by WannaCry and NotPetya ransomware.

Synopsis: The remote host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability in RDP.
Description: Pre-authentication remote code execution in Remote Desktop Services.
Solution: Apply the May 2019 security update and enable Network Level Authentication.

Synopsis: The remote OS is no longer supported.
Description: Windows Server 2012 reached end of extended support and no longer receives security patches.
Solution: Upgrade to a supported version of Windows Server.

Synopsis: The remote domain controller is affected by an elevation of privilege vulnerability.
Description: An attacker on the network can impersonate any computer including the domain controller itself.
Solution: Apply the August 2020 Netlogon security update and enforce secure RPC.

Synopsis: The web application is vulnerable to SQL injection.
Description: The 'id' parameter of /api/orders is concatenated into a SQL query, allowing data extraction.
Solution: Use parameterised queries and validate input server-side.

Synopsis: The web application is vulnerable to cross-site scripting.
Description: The 'q' parameter of /search is reflected without encoding, allowing script injection.
Solution: Encode output contextually and add a Content-Security-Policy.

Plugin Name: Citrix NetScaler ADC Session Token Leak (Citrix Bleed)
Synopsis: The remote NetScaler appliance leaks session tokens.
Description: Unauthenticated attackers can read memory containing session tokens and hijack authenticated sessions.
Solution: Upgrade NetScaler ADC and kill all active sessions.

Synopsis: The remote Java application uses a vulnerable Spring Framework version.
Description: Data binding on JDK 9+ allows remote code execution via class loader manipulation.

Synopsis: The remote web server runs an unsupported PHP version.
Description: PHP 7.4 is end-of-life and no longer receives security fixes.
Solution: Upgrade to a supported PHP version (8.2 or later).

Synopsis: The remote OpenSSL service leaks memory contents.
Description: A missing bounds check in the TLS heartbeat extension discloses up to 64 KB of memory, including private keys.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later and reissue certificates.

Plugin Name: SSL Medium Strength Cipher Suites Supported (SWEET32)
Synopsis: The remote service supports medium strength SSL ciphers.
Description: The service offers 64-bit block ciphers such as 3DES, vulnerable to SWEET32.
Solution: Disable 3DES and other medium strength ciphers.

Synopsis: The remote web server does not enforce HSTS.
Description: The Strict-Transport-Security header is not sent
See Also: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least one year.

Plugin Name: ICMP Timestamp Request Remote Date Disclosure
Synopsis: The remote host discloses its current time.
Description: The host answers ICMP timestamp requests.
Solution: Filter ICMP timestamp requests (13) and replies (14).

Synopsis: Signing is not required on the remote SMB server.
Description: An unauthenticated attacker can mount man-in-the-middle attacks against the SMB server.
Solution: Enforce message signing in the host's configuration.

Synopsis: A database server is listening on the remote host.
Description: The remote host is running MySQL 8.0.33.
Solution: Restrict access to the database port to application servers only.

Synopsis: It was possible to enumerate CPE names that matched on the remote system.
